name: BMAAC! -Atashi, Reichourui Yamemasen-
original_name: BMAAC!　―あたし、霊長類やめません―
source:
Kotogai, my classmate, makes fun of me everyday for having an animated face.
――Do I want to keep being the butt of his quips?

[Translated from [url=https://kumakumaf.amigasa.jp/kao/kao.html]official website[/url]]
translation:
就因为我的面部表情稍微丰富搞笑了一点，同班同学狐兔谷每天都拿我寻开心。
——我真的甘心一直这样当他的笑料吗？

[译自[url=https://kumakumaf.amigasa.jp/kao/kao.html]官方网站[/url]]
